_README.what: Hand-written labels for the 30-résumé real-corpus subset (C1 Table 1b).
_README.who: Labelled by the implementing agent (Claude) against the .txt rendering of each résumé, reading the full document. NOT independently human-verified — stated as a limitation in eval/RESULTS.md.

unlabelable_fields.name: The corpus is anonymised: no résumé carries a candidate name. The first line is the job title, not a person.
unlabelable_fields.work[].company: Every employer is redacted to the literal string 'Company Name'. There is no company to extract, so scoring it would measure the extractor's willingness to echo a placeholder.

_README.skills_rule: Labelled as the résumé's OWN skills/highlights/qualifications section, verbatim items, in document order. Where a résumé has no such section, skills is [] and that empty is a real label (the section is genuinely absent), not a missing annotation.
_README.title_rule: Job titles as written in the experience section, in document order, deduplicated only when the same title appears for the same date range.
_README.summary_rule: The text under the résumé's summary/profile/overview header, verbatim. Scored with long_text_f1 (token overlap), never exact match.
